analyses.summary: Patient forgot the visit after receiving no reminder message and requested a rebook for next week.
analyses.recommended_action: Reschedule appointment for next week and verify contact details to ensure SMS/call reminders are enabled.

analyses.summary: Patient resides far from the clinic, could not find transportation, and considers distance excessive for routine visits.
analyses.recommended_action: Offer teleconsultation options or assist in identifying closer clinic affiliates/transport options.

analyses.summary: Patient skipped the visit due to high consultation fees and inquired about follow-up discounts.
analyses.recommended_action: Inform patient regarding discounted follow-up fee structures, financial aid, or sliding scale options.
Contact patient to identify reason for missed appointment and update follow-up notes.

analyses.summary: Patient was bedridden with high fever and body ache on the appointment day, planning to visit upon recovery.
analyses.recommended_action: Follow up in a few days to assess recovery and reschedule the appointment.

analyses.summary: Patient could not attend due to an urgent office meeting and requested an evening appointment slot.
analyses.recommended_action: Reschedule the patient into an evening consultation slot as requested.

analyses.summary: Patient forgot the visit because no SMS was received and requested rebooking.
analyses.recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment and verify mobile number to ensure automated SMS delivery.

analyses.summary: Patient could not attend due to a city bus strike, lack of local auto-rickshaws, and significant distance.
analyses.recommended_action: Offer a rescheduled date or provide telemedicine options to alleviate travel barriers.

analyses.summary: Patient was unreachable across three attempts as the phone was switched off.
analyses.recommended_action: Attempt contact via alternate channels (email, secondary contact) or try calling at a later time.

analyses.summary: Patient experienced a factory shift change, was unable to take leave, and requested a Saturday appointment.
analyses.recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment to an available Saturday slot.
